kaynak_en: USGS Astrogeology, THEMIS Thermal Inertia Mosaic, Quantitative 32-bit, 100 m (Fergason et al.; method Fergason, Christensen and Kieffer 2006, JGR 111, E12004). https://asc-astropedia.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Mars/Odyssey/THEMIS-Global-Thermal-Inertia-Mosaic/Quantitative-32-Bit/THEMIS_TI_Mosaic_Quant_00N060E_100mpp.cub
